title: Add Premier League club crests to team cards
objective: Improve team recognition without restoring visual clutter to the minimal team-selection list.

source.team_ids: Premier League public 2025/26 competition team data

changes: Added a 20-team Premier League crest-ID and abbreviation mapping for the current release.
Added a 32px club crest to the left of each team name.
Kept team cards free of readiness badges and player counts.
Preserved matched-player text only when search makes it relevant.
Added a three-letter fallback badge if a crest image fails to load.
Configured crest images for lazy loading and asynchronous decoding.
guarantees: Every canonical team in the current product metadata has a crest mapping.
A failed external crest request does not remove the team identity or break team selection.
Crests are decorative for accessibility because the adjacent team name remains the accessible identity.
Team selection, readiness, EV and player-selection logic are unchanged.
